title: 摩根资管：亚洲主动ETF渗透率加速，中国前景有多强？
speaker: Travis Spence

segments.en: I mean, obviously we talked about how different the US is.
segments.zh: 显然我们谈到了美国有多么不同。

segments.en: How does adoption look like for China do you think compared to markets like Taiwan?
segments.zh: 你认为中国相比台湾等市场，采用情况如何？

segments.en: Well, let's look at that. So again, the US number is 13% of assets are sitting in active ETFs.
segments.zh: 我们来看看。美国的数据是，13%的资产配置在主动型ETF中。

segments.en: And that's really been growing over the last five years, mainly.
segments.zh: 这主要是在过去五年里真正增长起来的。

segments.en: In Korea, the numbers are already over 20% sitting active ETFs.
segments.zh: 在韩国，这个数字已经超过20%配置在主动型ETF中。

segments.en: In Australia, it's about 15% in Taiwan just announced active ETFs just two years ago already at 10%.
segments.zh: 在澳大利亚约为15%，台湾两年前才推出主动型ETF，现在已经达到10%。

segments.en: So I think what's happening is you've got, even though it's growing from a lower base, you've got the advantage of seeing this market develop.
segments.zh: 所以我认为正在发生的是，尽管基数较低，但你有机会看到这个市场的发展。

segments.en: It's now a 2.7 trillion market globally that really came up in the last five years.
segments.zh: 现在全球市场规模达2.7万亿美元，主要是在过去五年里崛起的。

segments.en: So it's now a kind of a market that's too big to ignore.
segments.zh: 所以现在这是一个不容忽视的市场。

segments.en: And you're seeing the adoption, I think, increase even faster across Asia.
segments.zh: 而且我认为在亚洲，采用速度正在加快。

segments.en: So prospects for China, I think, are really strong.
segments.zh: 所以我认为中国的前景非常强劲。

segments.en: Hopefully we see a lot more innovation. The opening up of more active ETFs and more rounds of ETFs.
segments.zh: 希望看到更多创新，更多主动型ETF和更多轮次的ETF开放。

segments.en: But I think this one's really important. And it's going to, I think, kick off a really interesting dynamic in China.
segments.zh: 但我认为这一点非常重要，它将在内地市场引发非常有趣的动态。

segments.en: So China has been quite a love part of the market, right?
segments.zh: 内地市场一直是市场参与者非常青睐的部分，对吧？
